institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

children-benefit-faster.title: Mentioning benefits for children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-benefit-faster.body: Pitches that highlight social or educational benefits for children tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-family-status-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their general family structure fund faster.
female-family-status-faster.body: Pitches from women that include general information about their family structure tend to accelerate funding speed.

female-demographic-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who include specific demographic details fund more slowly.
female-demographic-detail-slower.body: Pitches from women that specify exact demographic figures, such as the number of children, relationship status, or husband's occupation, tend to decelerate funding speed.

female-loan-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a history of previous loan repayments fund faster.
female-loan-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference a successful track record of repaying previous loans tend to accelerate funding speed.

female-pitch-length-slower.body: Lengthier pitches may lead to slower funding for female borrowers.

male-risk-mention-faster.body: Male borrowers who explicitly mention operational risks, such as power cuts or fires, may fund faster than those describing routine activities.

male-product-listing-slower.body: Male borrowers who list specific products being sold may fund more slowly.

female-business-quantities-faster.body: Female borrowers who include specific quantities or currency amounts in their business descriptions may fund faster.

female-generic-business-label-slower.body: Female borrowers who use generic business labels, such as 'sari-sari store', may fund more slowly.

female-geographic-location-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention a specific geographical location may fund faster.

female-saving-to-expand-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the specific goal of saving money to expand may fund more slowly.

female-academic-specificity-slower.body: Female borrowers who specify their exact academic field of study may fund more slowly.

female-local-currency-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who include direct thank you notes to lenders may fund more slowly.

female-character-descriptors-faster.title: Female borrowers who use character-based descriptors like 'dedication' or 'resilience' may fund faster.
female-character-descriptors-faster.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retirement.

female-gratitude-slower-revisited.title: Female borrowers who include direct thank you notes to lenders may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower-revisited.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retirement.

female-qualitative-vs-quantitative-detai.title: Qualitative personal identifiers (like names) may accelerate funding for women, while quantitative demographic data (like marital status) may decelerate it.
female-qualitative-vs-quantitative-detai.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retirement.

pitch-length-slower.title: Pitches with a higher word count or greater overall length tend to fund more slowly for both male and female borrowers.
pitch-length-slower.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retirement.

female-education-level-faster.title: Pitches from women that explicitly state the borrower's level of education tend to accelerate funding speed.
female-education-level-faster.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retirement.

female-environmental-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed descriptions of their local environment or business operations fund more slowly.
female-environmental-detail-slower.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retirement.

female-collateral-mention-faster.title: Mentioning a lack of collateral may accelerate funding speed for female borrowers.
female-collateral-mention-faster.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retirement.

female-outcome-input-distinction.title: Pitches from women highlighting skill development or asset acquisition accelerate funding, whereas listing specific technical inputs like seeds or fertilizers decelerates it.
female-outcome-input-distinction.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim regarding asset ownership.

local-currency-slower-female.title: Female borrowers who mention the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.
local-currency-slower-female.retrospective: Retired to make room for new emotive language puzzle.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Pitches that highlight owning assets or a lack of rental obligations accelerate funding for both men and women.
asset-ownership-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim on loan history.
